title: Prop pass odds: MFFU Pro 50K evaluation, the rule's own NQ trades

rules.engine_defaults: lockOffset $100, max 252 eval days; funded phase not used for pass odds

engine.method: block bootstrap of 5-day blocks of the strategy's own trading days, 5,000 simulated evaluations, seed 20261001
engine.costs: engine re-prices commissions: NQ mini $4.68 round trip, micro $1.90; 1 tick slippage stays in the trades
engine.pass_def: pPass = share of evaluations that hit +$3,000 before the trailing drawdown (blow-up = pBust)

size_choice.headline: 1 MNQ (1 micro NQ)
size_choice.why: The reel's $2,000 trailing drawdown is the MFFU 50K rule. Its run B wins $296 and loses $201 on average; our rule at 1 micro NQ wins about $215 and loses about $104 a trade (engine sizing), at 1 mini $2,162 and $1,026. So 1 micro is the dollar scale closest to the reel's run, and the only size where one average loser is a small part of $2,000. 1 NQ mini is shown too: one worst NQ trade (-$8,299) is four times the whole drawdown.

micro_approx.note: engine sizing: micro pnl = (mini pnl + $4 commission) / 10 - $1.90 micro round trip

reel_size_B.source: SPEC 'What the reel shows', config B

tv_window.label: NQ 3m X0, TradingView 1 May 2025 - 1 Oct 2026, 1,128 trades
tv_window.caveat: MAE is not in the TradingView export, so intraday drawdown inside a trade is not counted (closed-trade equity only). Real pass odds are this or lower: these are an UPPER bound.

local_history.label: NQ 3m X0, local Databento 1 Feb 2021 - 30 May 2025, 3,500 trades, MAE from 1-minute bars
local_history.caveat: the long history that still had a gross edge (PF 1.076); intraday drawdown counted

headline.line: Reel: 79.9% pass. Ours on the same $2,000 drawdown at 1 MNQ: 15.3% pass, 84.7% blow-up (median 32 trading days when it does pass). Best size of 12: 5 micros at 16.8%.

note: A strategy that loses money still passes sometimes: the 15-17% are lucky runs of the bootstrap, not an edge (PF 0.940).
